title: Atomic KPI verifier grant wakes eligible evidence wait
required_tests: src/__tests__/pair-p15-10c.test.ts#KVA grant wake for settled KPI evidence queue
description: HIGH-risk scheduler/KPI endpoint repair vs BASE e0885f7de03e2a961680a3b72e458fb398bb4a62. (1) WAITING_EVIDENCE/VERIFIED_KPI_EVIDENCE deadlock: owner-scoped canonical KPI grant wakes a settled quiet queue atomically inside the same store.immediate as the grant; scheduler.notifyKpiVerifierGrant re-proves queue state, authority binding, no active lease, KVA identity+schema+digest+effective state, then writes a receipt-bound (kpi-verifier-grant:<authorization_id>) idempotent wake + pending_generation bump. Healthy/quarantined/blocked/active/non-KPI waits and malformed/forged/revoked/expired/foreign grants never wake; grant never mints progress — KVR comes only from the pass verifier. (2) Precision defect found by the real e2e: the pass's OWN verifier write (advance->recordProgress) bumps objective row.version, which raw-version pins treated as drift -> mid-pass DRIVER_AUTHORITY_LOST. Pins in claimable/requireCurrent/requireRebind/currentLease now bind authority identity only (policy_version, terms_digest_binding, terms_current = live objective_digest, owner, business, effective); terms/status/owner drift still fails closed, runtime progress/spend writes do not count as drift. No lease lifecycle/heartbeat/retry/sign-off changes; objective_version kept for diagnostics. AUDIT R1 CLOSURE — regression-only, zero production diff: new R3 tests in pair-p15-10c-r2 prove every commit boundary still fails closed without the raw version pin: external recordProgress mid-CEO-await -> attempt STALE, zero decision rows (R1-KPI); external accountBudget mid-await -> same (R1-BUD); pass's own runtime write -> gate holds, settle commits (R1-SELF); owner amend mid-pass -> DRIVER_AUTHORITY_LOST, no settle (R1-AMEND); drift between PRIORITIZE review and allocation -> bounded WAITING via observation re-proof, zero WAL (R1-DISP); pause/resume covered by R2-F1a. No bypass confirmed.
